who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane blaze-remote, fix-hello-1113, round 3
where: crates/blaze-remote/src/pull.rs store_error, at the Source boundary; crates/blaze-keyed/src/store.rs StoreError::Remote
what: A bucket failure or a refused index object (a root, key list or shard) crosses into the store as StoreError::Remote { what: &'static str, status: u32 }, which cannot name the object or the signer, so the store's error says 'an object of the bucket refused: its signature does not verify' without saying which object.
cost: an error that does not name its thing (rule errors-name-the-thing) on every remote find that fails; the remote's own Failure names the object but is dropped at the boundary
cause: StoreError is a closed, string-free enum and the remote's refusals of its own objects have no variant in it; only a segment's statement (Refused) and wire layouts (WireError) do
class: a typed error boundary whose target enum has no variant carrying the source's identifying fields
prevention: a StoreError variant for a refused remote object carrying the object's name (a bucket key, which is built only from validated parts) and a typed reason, e.g. RemoteRefused { object: String, why: RemoteWhy }; asked of the store's owner in the round 3 report
workaround: store_error maps each Why and Failure to a fixed phrase; the full Failure (with the object) is still what blaze-remote's own commands print
fix: none yet: needs the store's owner to add the variant
